name: Ferdinand Bolstraat
wikipediaExtract: The Ferdinand Bolstraat is a street south of the city centre of Amsterdam, named after the artist Ferdinand Bol in 1872.

name: Koningsplein
wikipediaExtract: Koningsplein ('King's Square') is a square in Amsterdam. It is located between the Singel and Herengracht canals. It has become a meeting place for the local community.

Markenplein (Marken Square) is the name of a square in the centre of Amsterdam. Until 1970, it was called het oude Markenpleintje and before World War II it used to be a part of the Jewish district of Amsterdam. The name Markenplein symbolizes the bond between the new neighborhood and the old Jewish neighborhood.
